heading: Tuesday, April 21, 2026
topLine: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 and gpt-image-2.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 and gpt-image-2
items.summary: ChatGPT Images 2.0, powered by gpt-image-2, adds a thinking mode that plans compositions before generating, outputs up to 2K resolution, and improved dense and multilingual text rendering. It is available in ChatGPT, Codex and the API.
